claims.statement: This repository builds the Mintlify site docs.langchain.com from authored files in src/ into generated build/ output. DocumentationBuilder clears build/ and emits Python and JavaScript OSS variants, unversioned OpenWiki and Deep Agents Code content, LangSmith content, Managed Deep Agents variants, and shared files.

Local development requires running 'make install' to install dependencies and 'make dev' to start a development server at localhost:3000 that watches /src for changes and provides live preview through Mintlify.

`make test` runs pytest against tests/unit_tests with network sockets disabled except Unix sockets. Core CI runs on pushes to main, pull requests, and manual dispatch, and invokes that test target alongside separate lint, link, and cross-reference checks.

The development command runs an initial build unless --skip-build is supplied, starts a FileWatcher for src, and launches `mint dev --port 3000` with build as its working directory; it exits rather than continuing when the initial build fails.
src/docs.json is the Mintlify navigation and site-configuration source of truth, and contributors must update it when adding pages; generated build output must not be edited.
Most OSS documentation is generated into Python and JavaScript route variants, while OpenWiki and Deep Agents Code are unversioned output exceptions.

The repository exposes distinct validation targets: broken-links-with-anchors builds first and checks generated links and anchors; check-cross-refs validates source `@[ref]` references; test-code-samples executes selected or all code samples; lint checks Ruff, ty, and Codespell; lint_prose installs and runs a pinned Vale binary on source prose.
The project requires Python 3.13 or later; `make install` synchronizes all Python dependency groups, installs project npm dependencies, and installs the global Mintlify CLI.

Core CI regenerates `src/oss/python/integrations/providers/overview.mdx` with `pipeline/tools/partner_pkg_table.py` and rejects a resulting diff, so changes to that overview must be made through the generator or `packages.yml` and regeneration rather than by hand editing.

Repository-wide rules are in `AGENTS.md` and its byte-identical `CLAUDE.md`, while task-specific authoring procedures are canonical `SKILL.md` files under `.agents/skills/`; most listed agents discover that tree directly, whereas Claude Code needs `make skills` to create and maintain links under `.claude/skills/.`

Runnable documentation sample source files under `src/code-samples/` are executed by `make test-code-samples`, and `make code-snippets` extracts them into an intermediate and generates importable MDX snippets; generated snippet output is not the authored input.

The code-sample workflow skips fork pull requests, runs only changed supported sample files for internal pull requests, and uses scheduled or manual full runs to test all samples, enable tracing, regenerate snippets, and update a trace-refresh pull request only after successful testing and generation.

The pull-request version-claim workflow selects changed MDX files under `src/` and checks their version specifiers with `scripts/check_version_claims.py --files`. The checker reports failed registry lookups as unresolved but fails a non-advisory run when a successfully resolved PyPI or npm release set lacks the claimed version.

A Monday 08:00 UTC or manually dispatched workflow runs `scripts/check_external_versions.py --write` and opens or updates a standing refresh pull request when registered upstream-owned version requirements drift; its full-tree version sweep is advisory. Write mode replaces only the configured captured version digits, so surrounding requirement prose still requires review.
